{{Top|leg}}
'''Labor Pool Overseer''' was the title given to the crewmember aboard the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] responsible for overseeing the work assignments of the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and crew complement. Right before the [[Battle of Toprawa]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Overseer assigned the droids aboard the starship. The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and his [[Counterpart/Legends|counterpart]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] were given special assignment to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Antilles]].
